I want reviewers that list their top five games of all time and the last three games they played. I want games reviewed by more than one person, offering more than one perspective. I want games reviewed within the historical context of the genre they exist in. I want games reviewed without rewarding or penalizing them for personal feefees about the subject matter.

To expand on the last point, I would like to present the film The Birth of a Nation. The Birth of a Nation is an almost criminally racist and prejudiced film from 1915 that glorifies the Ku Klux Klan and demonizes black men. It also remains significant because, objectively, it is an amazingly well made film for its time, it pioneered film techniques, it did things that hadn't been done and it effectively advanced the medium of film. It is, despite its socially reprehensible message, a good film, certainly when taken within the context of filmmaking at that point in history.

I want a website that shows the same amount of disdain and disgust at the modern face of Big Business gaming as I feel and approaches the big publishers with the same antagonism as Kotaku and Polygon approach the fans of videogames. I want a site that tells me every time there is a review embargo, everytime there were no review copies, everytime a publisher tries to pull some shady ass shit. I want a watchdog for the customer, not some social awareness that I don't give a fuck about.
